column3: “a god who will go” renders the plural “gods (elohim) who will go.”
“This is your god” renders the plural “These are your gods”; “a graving tool” renders a word whose meaning is uncertain.
“Go down at once” renders “go, go down.”
“This is your god” renders the plural “These are your gods,” and “worshiped” renders “bowed down to.”
“an obstinate people” renders “a people stiff of neck.”
“destroy them” renders “make an end of them.”
“entreated the LORD” renders “entreated the face of the LORD.”
“the cry of triumph” and “the cry of defeat” render “the singing of strength” and “the singing of weakness.”
“at the foot of the mountain” renders “under the mountain.”
“out of control” renders “let loose,” and “their enemies” renders “those who rise against them”; the meaning of the clause is uncertain.
“go back and forth” renders “pass and return.”
“as Moses instructed” renders “according to the word of Moses.”
“Dedicate yourselves” renders “fill your hand,” which may also be read as a past “you have filled your hand.”
